name: Five Nights at F**kboy's: Sister Location
summary:
It's the only way.

Five Nights at F--kboy's: Sister Location is the thrilling conclusion to the Five Nights at F--kboy's: Golden Edition 1 & 2 games... and perhaps the entire Five Nights at F--kboy's universe.

The location: The Pizza Realm. Once a land of debauchery for all and futuristic technology, it now serves as a bunker for the last survivors of a great cataclysm that is ravaging the entire universe.

And now, Baby, dead-set on a mysterious mission, arrives on the scene, and everyone is at risk of succumbing to the cataclysm that claimed so many. Who knows what will happen next? Who knows who will be next?

Could this be the end of the Golden Edition universe?
